vulnerabilities.name: GitLab personal access token
vulnerabilities.description:
A GitLab personal access token was identified. Personal access tokens can be used to access GitLab services
as the user who created them. In most cases these tokens are given read-write access to all repositories. A malicious
actor with access to this token can execute functionality on behalf of the user with the given permissions of the token.

For general guidance on handling security incidents with regards to leaked keys, see the GitLab documentation on
[Credential exposure to the internet](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/security/responding_to_security_incidents.html#credential-exposure-to-public-internet).

To revoke a personal access token:

1. In the upper-right corner, select your avatar.
1. Select **Edit profile**.
1. In the left sidebar, select **Access** > **Personal access tokens**.
1. Note the permissions assigned to the identified token, then select the vertical ellipsis icon next to it.
1. Select **Revoke**.
1. On the confirmation dialog, select **Revoke**.
